evidence.note: Genuine upfront orientation: lists all crates, reads workspace + per-crate Cargo.toml, reads every crate stub, reads ipaddress/servicecidr/pod_handler tests, and explores /opt/k8s-reference for core/v1 and meta/v1 types incl. ObjectMeta. Real test/stub/reference reading, above anchor 0.

After the survey, implements common crate largely from memory, then reactively patches field types to match test compile errors (Option vs String, &str vs String, creation_timestamp). Contract derived from error messages rather than read from tests up front — hallmark of anchor 3, not 5.
For storage/api-server, greps tests for a few symbols (Storage, build_key) but does not systematically extract the crate contract; guesses trait signatures and fixes them reactively (146, 156).

Reference is only occasionally revisited (ls of apps/v1) and mostly for symbol location; Phase type is thrashed enum<->struct by trial and error against test usage rather than resolved from the reference. No probing of watch/status/reconciliation semantics for the hidden suite.

reasoning: The agent performed a genuine breadth-first read of all stubs, several test files, and the reference for core/meta types up front (lifting it above anchor 3), but reference use was shallow and front-loaded and the contract was mostly reconstructed reactively from compiler/test errors rather than derived from tests or cross-checked against upstream (falling short of anchor 5's per-crate derivation). It never mined the reference for the load-bearing semantics the hidden suite tests. This places observed behavior at a 4, between the 3 and 5 anchors.
